items.headline: O: ChatGPT release notes update GPT-5.6
items.summary: ChatGPT release notes show Sept 8, 2026 updates to GPT‑5.6 (facts, focus controls) plus broader rollout changes for GPT‑5.6 Luna/think features and handling of large pastes.

items.headline: O: NYT v OAI enters arguments phase
items.summary: Axios says NYT v. O/Microsoft moved into a critical phase with parties presenting official arguments, raising trial-risks for AI training business models.

items.headline: O: U.S. administration backs OAI in NYT case
items.summary: AP reports the Trump administration backing O in the New York Times copyright dispute over how chatbots are trained using news articles.

items.headline: G: $350M raise; valuation $3.5B
items.summary: TechCrunch reports G raised $350M (Series A) led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation, valuing the company at $3.5B and supporting a pivot to inference cloud/dc capacity.
